steps.eval: (()=>{const sb=rocksy.sidebar;for(const e of rocksy.tree.entries) if(e.isDir) sb.expanded.add(e.path);const t0=performance.now();sb.flatten();const flat=performance.now()-t0;const ms=[];const max=sb.rows.length*26;for(let i=0;i<60;i++){sb.treeEl.scrollTop=Math.floor(max*i/60);sb.renderedFrom=-1;const t=performance.now();sb.renderRows();void sb.sizer.offsetHeight;ms.push(performance.now()-t)}ms.sort((a,b)=>a-b);sb.treeEl.scrollTop=Math.floor(max*0.5);sb.renderedFrom=-1;sb.renderRows();return JSON.stringify({rows:sb.rows.length, flattenMs:+flat.toFixed(2), renderMedianMs:+ms[30].toFixed(2), renderP95Ms:+ms[57].toFixed(2), rowsInDom:sb.sizer.children.length})})()

(async()=>{const sb=rocksy.sidebar;const out=[];for(const q of ['p','pr','pro','proj','proje','projet','projet/','','e','eq','equipe','theme','a','xyz']){sb.tagInput.value=q;const t=performance.now();await sb.refreshTags();void sb.tagList.offsetHeight;out.push([q,+(performance.now()-t).toFixed(1),rocksy.metrics.tagsListCount,T.count('.tag-row')])}sb.tagInput.value='';await sb.refreshTags();return JSON.stringify(out)})()

(()=>{const f=rocksy.sidebar.fragments[3];const s=T.view().state;const l=s.doc.lineAt(s.selection.main.head);const lines=[];for(let i=f.startLine;i<=f.endLine;i++)lines.push(s.doc.line(i+1).text.slice(0,90));return JSON.stringify({fragment:{start:f.startLine,end:f.endLine,tagLine:f.tagLine,tag:f.tag,source:f.source}, cursorLine0:l.number-1, blockLines:lines.slice(0,6), flashed:T.count('.cm-lp-flash'), doc:rocksy.activeDoc().name, samePath:rocksy.activeDoc().path===f.path})})()

(async()=>{const tags=await T.inv('tags_list',{query:''});const kinds={};const out=[];let seed=7;const rnd=()=>{seed=(seed*1103515245+12345)&0x7fffffff;return seed/0x7fffffff};const cache={};let tries=0;while(out.length<8&&tries<400){tries++;const t=tags[Math.floor(rnd()*tags.length)];const fr=await T.inv('tag_fragments',{tag:t.tag,limit:20});if(!fr.length)continue;const f=fr[Math.floor(rnd()*fr.length)];if(f.source!=='inline')continue;const text=cache[f.path]||(cache[f.path]=(await T.inv('read_file',{path:f.path})).text);const L=text.split(/\r\n|\n/);const first=L[f.startLine]||'';const kind=/^\s*#{1,6}\s/.test(first)?'titre':/^\s*\|/.test(first)?'tableau':/^\s*>/.test(first)?'citation':/^\s*([-*+]|\d+[.)])\s/.test(first)?'liste':'paragraphe';if((kinds[kind]||0)>=2)continue;kinds[kind]=(kinds[kind]||0)+1;out.push({kind,tag:f.tag,file:f.path.split('\\').pop(),start:f.startLine,end:f.endLine,tagLine:f.tagLine,tagCol:f.tagCol,atCol:(L[f.tagLine]||'').substr(f.tagCol,f.tag.length+1),before:(L[f.startLine-1]??'<debut>').slice(0,70),block:L.slice(f.startLine,f.endLine+1).map(x=>x.slice(0,90)).slice(0,7),blockLen:f.endLine-f.startLine+1,after:(L[f.endLine+1]??'<fin>').slice(0,70)})}return JSON.stringify({tags:tags.length,kinds,samples:out})})()

(()=>{const t0=performance.now();const r=rocksy.completeFiles('budg');const ms=performance.now()-t0;return JSON.stringify({popup:T.count('.cm-tooltip-autocomplete li'), first:(document.querySelector('.cm-tooltip-autocomplete li')||{}).textContent, completeFilesMs:+ms.toFixed(2), n:r.length})})()
